onThisDay.text: The Indian Air Force was founded, laying the institutional groundwork for the nation's modern military aviation capabilities.
The devastating Kashmir earthquake struck, causing massive loss of life and displacement across the region.
Premchand, the legendary author often called the Upanyas Samrat, died, leaving behind a profound legacy in Hindi and Urdu literature.
Marxist revolutionary Che Guevara was captured in Bolivia, marking a turning point in Latin American guerrilla history.
The Great Chicago Fire erupted, destroying much of the city's central business district and profoundly shaping modern urban fire safety laws.
